commits.subject: net: some THttpRedirectOptions fixes
commits.body:
- especially about the Referer: purge
- and with proper URI comparison
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed 204 responses for the Proxy Cache
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: new THttpRedirectOptions set of options for THttpClientSocket
commits.body: - enhance the security features during 3xx redirection process
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed some other Proxy Cache status issues
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed THttpProxyServer HEAD/GET response codes
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed Proxy Cache process
commits.body:
- abort all progressive clients associated with any failed download
- only accept 2xx for successfull GET download of a resource - just like the Peer Cache
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed THttpPeerCache to include Location: for 3xx redirections
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: enhanced THttpProxyUrl.RemoteClientHead
commits.body:
- better 2xx and 3xx responses support
- more logged context about the sockets client on error
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed THttpClientSocket redirections on the same server
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: THttpClientSocket should keep HEAD for HTTP_MOVEDPERMANENTLY
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: minor TAsyncConnections.IdleEverySecond cleanup
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed WebSockets HeartbeatDelay async server support
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: rewritten TPollAsyncConnection.ReleaseMemoryOnIdle
commits.body:
- is called only once during its idle state and not every second
- cleaner and more maintainable code
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: idle TPollAsyncConnection release its INetTls buffers
commits.body:
- no-op on OpenSSL (SSL_MODE_RELEASE_BUFFERS already available)
- but properly implemented on SChannel
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: introducing INetTls.ReleaseBuffers method
commits.body:
- OpenSSL can't safely implement it, but won't need it
- our SChannel TLS layer can easily implement it
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: refined SChannel TLS buffer size
commits.body:
- output buffers are now 2KB and seem good enough for most simple process
- exact maximum record size as reported by SSPI would be used instead of naive +25%
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: reduce TSChannelNetTls memory consumption per connection
commits.body: - start with 4KB buffers, then grow by 25%
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed previous commit
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: rewritten TSChannelNetTls.Receive core process
commits.body: - with a much cleaner design, and proper SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE lock support
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

 ## [2.5.stable] - trunk

 - HTTP over TFTP proxy
 ### Changed

 ## [2.4.stable] - 2026-01-13

commits.subject: net: some TSChannelNetTls cleanup/optimization
commits.body: - TOsLightLock is a better candidate on Windows so that Recv() is triggered ASAP
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed SChannel partial initial negotiation
commits.body: - ignore first server AcceptSecurityContext() after incomplete ClientHello
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: hardened TSChannelNetTls thread safety
commits.body:
- concurrent call of Recv() and Send() could happen with WebSockets
- we protect Recv() SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE vs Send() using a TLightLock
- output full buffers + SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE would abort the connection (should be very rare)
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez
